Definition: from G3409; a rented building:--hired house.
BiblicalUsage: The word is a hired house, and it appears once, at the end of Acts: Paul dwelt two whole years in his own hired house, and received all that came in unto him, preaching the kingdom of God.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that the hired house is the last picture of the mission: Paul in chains, in a rented room, and the gospel still going out to everyone who came.
